summary.intent: Fix a blank statusline and noisy GSD stop-hook error, update GSD, clean up stale worktrees, then plan and begin executing Phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) for the CipherBox crypto layer.
summary.outcome: Statusline restored (CJS rename fix), GSD reinstalled to 1.6.0 (restoring missing hooks), three worktrees removed cleanly. Phase 61 fully planned (5 plans, 4 waves), adversarial verification converged in 2 rounds with 0 remaining blockers, plans hardened against vacuous-pass KAT holes, and Wave 1 execution dispatched.

repo: package.json has `"type": "module"` — any hook written in CommonJS must use the `.cjs` extension or Node crashes silently on `require()` calls, leaving the statusline blank.
GSD hooks are gitignored via `.claude/hooks/gsd-*` pattern (.gitignore:55) — they are not tracked and must be regenerated by running the GSD installer after each fresh clone.
GSD is installed via `npx @opengsd/gsd-core` and is fully gitignored/regeneratable; .gitignore comment pins the canonical version at 1.6.0.
vitest is configured with `include: ['src/**/*.ts']` — KAT files must live at `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/` not `packages/crypto/__tests__/`; the latter path is silently ignored.

`scripts/check-vector-parity.sh` has a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array — adding a new vector file (e.g. `node-aad.json`) requires a matching entry or the CI parity step fails even when both TS and Rust tests pass.
`sealAesGcmAad` mints a fresh random IV on every call and cannot produce fixed output; fixed-IV KAT vectors must target the lower-level `encryptAesGcmAad`/`decrypt_aes_gcm_aad` pair instead.
The `uuid` crate is not yet in the workspace root `Cargo.toml` or `crates/crypto/Cargo.toml` — Phase 61 adds it as the only new workspace dependency.
Zero AAD consumers exist in either package today — Phase 61 is entirely additive with no consumer rewiring needed.
Wave 4 of Phase 61 contains two non-overlapping parallel plans (61-04 Rust, 61-05 docs) with zero shared `files_modified`.

code.finding: `.claude/hooks/gsd-*` is gitignored — GSD managed hooks are not tracked and disappear on fresh clones unless the installer is re-run.

Documents the deliberate stale-path correction: ROADMAP.md SC#3 and TEST-02 cite `packages/crypto/__tests__/build-node-aad.test.ts` but plans place the file at `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/` to match the vitest `include` glob.

TS aad_vectors KAT originally had no array-length assertion — a `for...of` over an empty array passes vacuously. Hardened to require `expect(vectors.aad_vectors).toHaveLength(4)` plus role-set assertion.
TS seal_vectors KAT had the same vacuous-pass hole. Hardened to assert `expect(vectors.seal_vectors.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)` mirroring the Rust `!seal_vectors.is_empty()` guard.
Contains a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` bash array. New vector files must be registered here explicitly or the CI parity-check step fails.

workflow: The GSD commit helper consistently false-negatives (reports failure when the commit actually lands) — always verify with `git log` after every commit.
Planner and pattern-mapper GSD subagents do not auto-commit their output artifacts; the orchestrator must commit RESEARCH.md, PATTERNS.md, VALIDATION.md, and PLAN files explicitly.
The `gsd-tools` state helper does not reliably update STATE.md `Current Position` during the plan-phase flow — hand-editing is required to reflect planning completion.
The GSD installer prompts interactively to keep/remove stale files on a broken/partial install; a `--remove` flag or non-interactive re-run is needed to avoid hanging.
Worktrees should be disabled for execute-phase when waves are single-plan and sequential — they lack `node_modules` and warm cargo cache, making them slower than running on the main tree.
`git worktree remove` detaches the working directory but leaves the branch intact — branches must be deleted separately if cleanup is desired.
For AFK sessions with 1Password SSH signing, disable commit signing locally (`git config commit.gpgsign false`) to prevent biometric prompts from wedging subagent commits.

Adversarial multi-lens plan verification (plan-checker + 3 independent crypto lenses in parallel, with auto-revision on BLOCKER) is worth the token cost for security-critical crypto phases where a byte mismatch causes silent total decryption failure.

friction: ESM/CJS conflict caused statusline to blank silently with no visible error — only discoverable by manually running the hook script.

GSD `gsd-context-monitor.js` stop-hook errored on every single turn (MODULE_NOT_FOUND) because the main-tree GSD install was a broken fragment with no manifest, no gsd-tools.cjs, and most workflows missing.
The broken GSD install meant the normal `/gsd-update` flow couldn't run — had to identify the installer command from `.gitignore` comments and run it directly via npx.
GSD installer required an interactive keep/remove decision for stale fragment files, blocking non-interactive execution and requiring a second run.
GSD commit helper false-negatives reliably, requiring a `git log` verification after every commit to confirm the commit landed — adds friction to every planning artifact commit.
CONTEXT.md contained a wrong test path (`packages/crypto/__tests__/`) that would have caused silent test discovery failure in CI — caught only by the researcher subagent reading vitest config.
STATE.md `Current Position` was not updated by gsd-tools after planning completed, requiring manual identification and hand-editing of the correct block.
open_items: Phase 61 execution in progress — Wave 1 (plan 61-01: TS AAD builder + KAT fixture) was dispatched when the transcript ends; Waves 2-4 and `/ship-phase` still pending.
